summary: Backend testing complete for Almacén Zetor API. 30/30 pytest cases passed against deployed external URL. Covers public catalog (site/config, categories, models, products, blog), contact lead creation, auth (login + cookie + bearer + 401), admin product CRUD (incl. duplicate SKU 400 and unauth 401), admin blog CRUD, admin leads list/delete, image upload, and verifies _id is excluded from all responses.
action_items: Optional: If admin endpoints should refuse cookie auth and only use Bearer in some flows, document expected behavior. Current behavior (cookie OR bearer) works as designed.
Optional: Consider adding rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (currently none).
Optional: /api/admin/leads/{id} returns 200 even for non-existing leads (delete_one swallows missing). Consider 404 for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 568 lines — still readable but approaching the 700 line threshold; consider splitting into routes/auth/seed modules as it grows.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. This is permissive for a preview env; in production restrict to explicit origins.
/api/admin/leads/{lead_id} DELETE does not check deleted_count; returns ok even if id doesn't exist (minor).
Seed compatibility heuristic in seed_products() includes m[:2] check that's effectively dead code (only m in name appended). Harmless but confusing.
Image upload reads full file into memory before size check; should stream for large file safety, though 10MB limit mitigates risk.
No brute-force protection on /auth/login. Acceptable for MVP but flagged.
test_credentials: admin@almacenzetorrepuestos.com / ZetorAdmin2026! — login works and matches /app/backend/.env. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present in this repo.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 47 products and 3 blog posts on startup (already present). Tests created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed product, blog post, and a couple of leads (one cleaned, one left for completeness).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 backend tests pass. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Note: requests.Session preserves the Set-Cookie from /auth/login, so any unauthenticated test must use a fresh requests.Session. Backend cookie uses samesite=none + secure + httponly. Bearer token also accepted via Authorization header. Frontend has not been tested.
rca of the issue: Initial 2 failures (test_create_unauth, test_leads_requires_auth) were caused by the shared requests.Session capturing the access_token cookie from a prior login fixture. Fix: use fresh Session in unauth tests. Backend behavior is correct.
